svg.title: Kyoto and Omi kettle lineages
svg.desc: A source-qualified chronology separates Kyoto metalwork context, Ryubundo and Kibundo records, wartime disruption, and the modern Unshikido revival. No direct succession arrow is claimed.

g.text: Kyoto / Ōmi: related records, not one succession
Evidence rule: proximity, a teacher claim, or a shared style does not prove a direct workshop succession.
